name: F. W. McKinney
bio: F. W. (Fred) McKinney of Bismarck visited Medora in 1884 with an officer of the Refrigerator Car Co. He stopped over again in April 1885.

moments.label: Visited Medora with Refrigerator Car Co. party

mentions: F. B. Allen, secretary of the N. P. Ref. Car Co., accompanied by Fred McKinney, of Bismarck, paid Medora a flying visit last week.
F. W. McKinney, of Bismarck, stopped over a train Tuesday.
